description: This file implements a Windows-specific dialog interface, including functions to create, display, handle messages, and cancel modal dialogs with OK and Cancel buttons, using Win32 API. It defines a DialogTemplateBuilder class for constructing dialog templates at runtime and manages dialog callbacks.

classes.name: DialogTemplateBuilder
classes.description: A helper class to construct Windows dialog templates dynamically in memory.

methods.name: DialogProcedureCallback
methods.description: Callback function handling dialog messages, particularly OK and Cancel commands.

methods.name: ShowOkCancelDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays a modal dialog with OK and Cancel buttons, with customizable callbacks.

methods.name: DialogHandleMessage
methods.description: Processes Windows messages for the current dialog.

methods.name: CancelDialog
methods.description: Programmatically closes the current dialog if open.
